summary.headline: CoinW snapshot 202609 is a weak Stage 0 (announcement / import summary): self-reported total USDT reserve ratio only; Cloudflare WAF blocks stable datacenter fetches of the PoR dashboard; no public wallet list.
summary.rationale: solvency-claim PASS means the September 2026 announcement total reserve ratio ≥ 100% only — not independently reproduced reserves or a bound merkle root. Official por-verify binaries exist without published source; user merkel_tree_cw.json remains login-gated. A later Oct-24 SSR panel was observed under geo-restriction with animated/conflicting merkle and ratio UI — left observational, not assessed.
